data.name: Primary Copper Balance Objective
data.text: Assess net copper balance with daily repeat-dose ALXN1840 treatment (15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with Wilson disease (WD)

data.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change Objective
data.text: Assess change in copper balance in response to ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day during ALXN1840 accumulation and at steady state periods versus the pretreatment baseline in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Objective
data.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 (15 mg/day and 30 mg/day) on the disposition of copper in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Objective
data.text: Investigate the effect of ALXN1840 on the disposition of molybdenum at steady state at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Objective
data.text: Assess steady-state total molybdenum balance as a measure of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Objective
data.text: Assess accumulation of molybdenum with ALXN1840 treatment at 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Objective
data.text: Determine the steady-state plasma pharmacokinetic (PK) of total molybdenum and plasma ultrafiltrate (PUF) molybdenum (as surrogate measures of ALXN1840, 15 mg and 30 mg) in participants with WD

data.name: Safety and Tolerability Objective
data.text: Evaluate the safety and tolerability of repeated-dose administration of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Dose Response Objective
data.text: Determine dose response of ALXN1840 15 mg/day and 30 mg/day for copper balance in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Objective
data.text: Determine the effect of treatment duration on copper balance in participants with WD

data.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and Copper Profiles Objective
data.text: Assess the effects of ALXN1840 on ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper LBC profiles in plasma in participants with WD

data.name: Primary Copper Balance Endpoint
data.text: Mean daily copper balance where copper balance is measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Copper Balance Change Endpoint
data.text: Change in mean daily copper balance as measured by the calculated difference between copper intake (in food and drink) and copper output (in feces and urine) from pretreatment baseline (Days -4 through -1) and ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Copper Disposition Endpoint
data.text: Copper quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, including plasma total and labile bound copper (LBC) during ALXN1840 accumulation and steady-state periods for each dose

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Disposition Endpoint
data.text: Molybdenum quantified in food, drink, feces, and urine, plasma total molybdenum at ALXN1840 steady state

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Balance Endpoint
data.text: Mean daily molybdenum balance as demonstrated through measurement of molybdenum intake (in food, drink and ALXN1840), and molybdenum output (feces and urine) representing ALXN1840 steady state

data.name: Secondary Molybdenum Accumulation Endpoint
data.text: Accumulation of molybdenum as determined by molybdenum balance

data.name: Secondary Pharmacokinetic Endpoint
data.text: PK parameters for plasma total and PUF-molybdenum

data.name: Safety Endpoint - TEAEs and SAEs
data.text: Treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs)/serious adverse events (SAEs)

data.name: Safety Endpoint - Clinical Laboratory Assessments
data.text: Clinical laboratory assessments (serum chemistry, hematology, coagulation, and urinalysis)

data.name: Safety Endpoint - Physical Examinations
data.text: Physical examinations

data.name: Safety Endpoint - ECG
data.text: Heart rate, intervals (PR, QRS, QT and QTc), and clinically significant electrocardiogram (ECG) findings as determined by triplicate 12-lead ECG

data.name: Safety Endpoint - Vital Signs
data.text: Vital sign assessments (blood pressure and heart rate)

data.name: Exploratory Dose Response Endpoint
data.text: Assess dose response of ALXN1840 on copper balance focusing on copper balance

data.name: Exploratory Treatment Duration Endpoint
data.text: Determine the effect of time following initiation of ALXN1840 treatment on copper balance

data.name: Exploratory Ceruloplasmin and Copper Profiles Endpoint
data.text: Ceruloplasmin, ceruloplasmin-bound copper, and LBC: Change in ceruloplasmin at Days 1, 8, 25, 29, 36, and Day 39 compared with predose

data.name: Primary Copper Balance Estimand - ALXN1840 15mg/day
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Wilson Disease enrolled in the study who receive ALXN1840 15 mg/day during inpatient periods with controlled diet and complete copper balance collection periods (All Enrolled Participants (Full Analysis Set)) Summary measure: Mean daily copper balance (mg/day) with descriptive statistics; net copper balance (negative indicating decoppering).

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose reduction or interruption due to safety concerns
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant requires dose reduction or interruption of ALXN1840 15 mg/day due to meeting dose modification criteria before completion of the copper balance collection period

intercurrentEvents.name: Study discontinuation before collection period completion
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant discontinues the study before completing the required copper balance collection period at 15 mg/day

intercurrentEvents.name: Outpatient period extension
intercurrentEvents.text: Outpatient period (Day 9 to Day 23) is extended up to an additional 14 days per adaptive protocol feature, potentially altering the timing of steady-state assessment

intercurrentEvents.name: Participant remains on 15 mg/day for full study duration
intercurrentEvents.text: Due to safety concerns, participant does not escalate to 30 mg/day and remains on 15 mg/day for the entire study duration

intercurrentEvents.name: Dietary non-compliance during inpatient period
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant deviates from the copper-controlled diet during the inpatient collection period, affecting copper intake measurements

data.variableOfInterest: Mean daily copper balance measured as the calculated difference between copper intake (food and drink) and copper output (feces and urine) during ALXN1840 15 mg/day accumulation and steady-state periods
data.summaryMeasure: Mean daily copper balance (mg/day) with descriptive statistics; net copper balance (negative indicating decoppering)
